protocol.study: P01 NBA conditional probability recalibration research
protocol.selection: Every independently resolved original saved numeric NBA main-market probability in the frozen audit; no confidence, side or hit/miss filtering. Pushes excluded from binary calibration.
protocol.development: Earliest60% of exact fixtures for training;latest40% for chronological diagnostic. All markets from one fixture stay in one partition. Earlier outcomes and this audit were already inspected: this is retrospective development, NOT untouched validation.
protocol.candidate: Per-market monotone logistic calibration:intercept0/slope1 initial;2000 gradient steps at0.1;ridge1 toward identity;slope bounded0..5;minimum30 training records. Fixed settings, no holdout tuning. Final candidate fit to all available resolved records only for a later prospective cohort.
protocol.benchmark: Original conditional OVER probability and constant0.5. No two-sided prices available: no no-vig book,EV or ROI claim.
